description_zh: 分页查询租户成员列表
name: ListUsers

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. The winnexo-cli passes this parameter explicitly by using --tenant-id
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

The maximum number of entries per page is 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页返回条目数。

每页返回数量上限30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keyword for searching products. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 搜索产品关键词支持模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the account is activated.
true: Activated.
false: Not activated
parameters.help_zh:
账号是否激活。
true：激活
false：未激活
parameters.name: is_active

parameters.help_en: The list of new system role codes (full replacement, at least one role must be included). Valid values: SUPER_ADMIN / SYSTEM_ADMIN / SEMANTIC_ADMIN / SKILL_ADMIN / KB_ADMIN / AGENT_ADMIN / APPLICATION_USER
parameters.help_zh: 新的系统角色 code 列表（全量替换，至少包含一个角色）。可选值: SUPER_ADMIN / SYSTEM_ADMIN / SEMANTIC_ADMIN / SKILL_ADMIN / KB_ADMIN / AGENT_ADMIN / APPLICATION_USER
parameters.name: role_codes

parameters.help_en: The list of Alibaba Cloud account IDs
parameters.name: account_ids
